lines.text: Paul asks Timothy to come quickly because Demas, loving this world, has deserted him and gone to Thessalonica.
Only Luke is with Paul, who tells Timothy to bring Mark and says he sent Tychicus to Smyrna.
Paul asks Timothy to bring the cloak left with Carpus at Troas, and the scrolls, especially the parchments.
Alexander the silversmith did Paul great harm, and Timothy should beware of him because he opposed their message.
At Paul's first defense everyone deserted him, but the Lord stood by him so all the Gentiles would hear the message.
